about_the_game:
Make your childhood friend the world's most famous VTuber.

'LikeMe' is a clicker x idle x adventure game where you help your shut-in childhood friend debut as a VTuber and tackle the impossible goal of reaching 10 billion followers.

As the player, you support "Hiyori," your childhood friend who became a shut-in, in her activities as VTuber "Tsukimin." Experience an unprecedented clicker game using the familiar SNS "Like" button.

Features:

- Revolutionary Clicker Experience: Innovative game system using SNS "Like" buttons

- Reincarnation System: Fusion of VTuber "reincarnation" and idle game "rebirth." Each reincarnation increases SNS power and lets you enjoy new "Tsukimin" appearances and posting styles

- Adorable Visuals: Cute illustrations and characters for casual gaming

- SNS Reality: Realistic SNS experience with changing post content and fan interactions

- Moving Story: A warning about modern society obsessed with SNS numbers and the realization of what truly matters

An idle game of laughter and tears where you can experience the light and shadow of SNS and the importance of human connections.

Will you realize what truly matters?

name: Like Me
short_description: Turn your shut-in childhood friend into a VTuber and aim for 10 billion followers! Click SNS "Like" buttons in this clicker x idle x Adventure game. When growth slows, use "reincarnation" to boost SNS power and unlock new "Tsukimin" forms. A fresh take on modern SNS society with cute visuals.
